result.note: Editor's note sets out the April 2026 assembly election schedule; tested the polling and counting dates, skipping the freebie commentary.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the assembly elections held in five states and Union Territories in April 2026:
items: Kerala, Assam and Puducherry voted on the same day.
West Bengal voted in a single phase.
Results for all five assemblies were scheduled to be declared on the same day.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: West Bengal voted in two phases, on April 23 and 29, so statement 2 is wrong. Kerala, Assam and Puducherry voted on April 9, Tamil Nadu on April 23, and results for all five were due on May 4, with roughly 174 million voters covered.
questions.source: West Bengal votes in two phases on April 23 and 29.
